prompt:
[editor/rewrite task] You are given a knowledge-base style dossier and a draft article with multiple factual and structural issues. Your job is to produce a revised, publication-ready chief editor version that follows the attached sources, preserves required citations, and places the reference list at the very end of the entire article.

Requirements:
- Read every attached file completely.
- If any URLs appear in the attached files, inspect the most relevant ones before writing.
- Write a polished final article in English only.
- The article must be concise, accurate, and include a complete reference list at the very end of the document.
- Do not omit the requested section about evaluation criteria.
- If the draft includes multiple candidate headlines, choose the best one and keep the tone professional.
- Output only the final revised article to the required submission file.
